scripts.name: sysinfo
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
echo "╔════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║       LayerDroid SysInfo           ║"
echo "╚════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo
echo "▸ KERNEL"
uname -a
echo
echo "▸ CPU (primeiros 8 campos)"
head -8 /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null
echo
echo "▸ MEMÓRIA"
head -3 /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null
echo
echo "▸ UPTIME"
cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null
echo
echo "▸ DISPOSITIVO"
getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null
getprop ro.product.brand 2>/dev/null
getprop ro.build.version.release 2>/dev/null

scripts.name: ipcheck
scripts.description: Mostra IP público + info de geolocalização
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
echo "IP público:"
wget -qO- https://api.ipify.org 2>/dev/null || curl -s https://api.ipify.org 2>/dev/null
echo
echo "Info detalhada:"
wget -qO- http://ip-api.com/line/?fields=country,regionName,city,isp,org 2>/dev/null || curl -s http://ip-api.com/line/?fields=country,regionName,city,isp,org

scripts.name: calc
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
if [ -z "$1" ]; then
  echo "Uso: calc <expressão>"
  echo "Ex:  calc 2+3*4"
  exit 1
fi
echo "$@" | awk '{print}' 2>/dev/null
expr "$@" 2>/dev/null || echo "$@" | bc 2>/dev/null || echo "Expressão inválida"
